title: 半導體製程工藝
summary: 以 20 個模組、520 個學習步驟，拆解晶圓製作、元件、微影、薄膜、蝕刻、互連、量測與製程整合。
summaryEn: Twenty modules and 520 learning steps explore wafers, devices, lithography, films, etch, interconnects, metrology and integration.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學拆解；模組編號是學習順序，製程分支與實際前後關係另有說明。520 步不代表任何廠商的完整量產配方或固定製程數。所有步驟使用明確標示的代表照片；重複使用照片不等於每步專屬實拍。操作為原創概念模擬與工程推理，實驗資料需自行提供或查閱來源。
scopeEn: Educational subdivisions based on public principles. Module numbers describe learning order; process branches and actual dependencies are identified separately. The 520 steps are not a proprietary manufacturing recipe or universal process count. Every step has a labeled representative photograph; reused images are not step-specific process photography. Activities use original concept simulations and engineering reasoning; measured data must be supplied or obtained from sources.

stages.title: 製程整合與來料品質
stages.description: 建立能連結材料、座標、量測與元件路線的來料證據。26 個操作包含剖面建模與真實量測方法的判讀。
stages.descriptionEn: Build incoming evidence connecting material, coordinates, metrology and device routes. The 26 operations combine cross-section modeling with interpretation of real measurement methods.
stages.route: 教育模組；替代技術依步驟明示為分支，不代表同一片晶圓必須全部依序加工。
stages.routeEn: Educational module; alternatives are labeled as branches and are not mandatory sequential operations on one wafer.
